QuestInfo.name: Holding Back Nyalmo
QuestInfo.1: Scadur believes Nyalmo's angry because the Spirit of Snow Statue was destroyed. He suggests need to restore the statue as soon as possible. That will take time, however, so you should hold off on approaching Nyalmo until the job is done.
QuestInfo.2: You held off Nyalmo and went back to Scadur. He says Alcaster has completed his preparations to restore the sculpture, and tells you to go see him.

0.0: If the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture's broken, no wonder Nyalmo's angry. According to the legend, the Snow Spirit is his mother. Even he would get angry seeing his mother's statue shattered into pieces. Who would have done such a thing?
0.1: First things first. We need to restore the sculpture and calm Nyalmo's anger. But to do that, we'll need to buy more time. I need you to hold him off while the sculpture is being restored, so he won't start up an avalanche.

yes.0: You can find Nyalmo deep in the snowfield. Please hurry before an avalanche occurs. I'll conjure up a plan to restore the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture. I know just the person to ask about it.

no.0: You still don't understand? If Nyalmo's anger starts up an avalanche, all of El Nath will disappear!

1.0: Well, we're not buried in snow yet, so it looks like you did a good job. Nyalmo's strong; not just physically, but he's half-spirit too. Must've been tough, even for you.

yes.0: You're right on time. I've asked Alcaster to restore the sculpture, and he just finished preparing for it. Go meet Alcaster.

mob.0: Please hold Nyalmo off until the sculpture's restored.
